title: Functions & Logic
description: Master the art of writing reusable code with functions and learn to handle complex logic with loops.
learningObjectives: Define and call your own functions
Work with parameters and return values
Use for and while loops to automate repetitive tasks

sections.content: A function is a reusable block of code that performs a specific task. Use the `def` keyword to define one.

exercises.question: Define a function called `greet` that prints "Hi there!". Then call the function.
